1) **Your email**, or  
2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Then also send your **order id** (looks like `#W0000000`) so I can look up the delivered order, list the items (including the tablet and E-Reader), and tell you **the exact refund amount** for everything you want to return (keeping the tablet).
